activity.title: Kevin Xia ’28, Daniel Zhu ’29 and James Gómez CMC ’27 took first place in the spring 2026 #SageTank pitch competition, an event in which teams from across the five Claremont Colleges pitch their startups to a panel of venture capitalist partners and investors in front of a live audience. The team's project, Whistle, is an agentic NCAA compliance software designed to help athletic departments stay compliant with NCAA regulations, an often complicated and time-intensive process. The software allows anyone within an NCAA athletic department to ask a compliance question and receive precision answers, citing exact bylaws, within 30 seconds. “We love competition and winning, and entrepreneurship is a domain in which you are directly competing with others,” said Xia. “There is nothing else like it." Read more on our website at https://uqr.to/hmc-st26 .

We're excited to announce that P-ai is hosting the Claremont branch of Vercel v0’s “Prompt to Production” build event on Saturday, February 7, 2026 from 1–5pm. It’s fully virtual and low-commitment/hackathon-style—drop in, build something small, submit to the Vercel Community Showcase platform, and leave with a real prototype (app/agent) you can show off. Every builder will receive $10 of v0 credits to use. There will also be cash and credit prizes for winners across six tracks: Product, Design, Marketing, GTM, Dev, and Data/Internal Tools—plus an overall winner. Projects will be voted on by the Vercel community worldwide, so you’ll be competing (and getting visibility) beyond Claremont. RSVP on Luma: https://luma.com/okp7mdu4 and join the Slack channel: https://lnkd.in/gudHMv3X to get details + live updates.

We’re excited to announce a partnership between Anjuna Sports Acupuncture , a forward-thinking orthopedic sports acupuncture clinic in Eugene, Oregon, and Kandor (YC S26) , building the future of clinic operations. Anjuna has long been at the frontier of patient-centered, technology-forward care. Together, we’ll be working to bring AI-driven support into the operational backbone of the clinic, helping streamline insurance verification, billing workflows, denials, and patient billing while preserving the quality of care and patient experience Anjuna is known for. We’re excited to support Anjuna’s team and work together toward a more intelligent, transparent, and modern future for healthcare operations.
